g.text: Copper carrier: design the release, not just the joint
RWT-METALS | 30 October 2026 | not to scale; synthetic fixture, NOT construction dimensions
A Fixed opposed sockets: undoing fasteners does not remove the tube stops
fixed socket / stop
stop / fixed socket
rigid, axially constrained carrier
Synthetic example: left engagement 40; right engagement 50; separation allowance 5.
At both stops, available travel is 0 in either direction. First axial disengagement is impossible.
This does not prohibit a real union or a movable terminal: those change the mechanism.
B Remove one terminal BODY first: a separately designed service operation
terminal lifted clear
remaining left socket disengages by rightward travel
Authored free bay 80 minus required first movement (40 + 5) = 35 remaining.
A 44 bay fails. Even an 80 bay proves neither full withdrawal nor how the terminal was removed.
Retained olive / plate / support must fit the sleeve. Unknown envelopes remain unknown.
C Two different water boundaries, plus an independent support duty
W1 Pipe bore and terminal joint: contain conveyed water, including the actual surcharge case.
W2 Court pan / sleeve outside: prevent floodwater bypass; preserve visible outward leak drainage.
S Carrier and terminal support: carry loads without asking a seal to act as a bearing.
A pressure-capable W1 fitting does not prove W2. A removable cover does not prove renewal.
Development choice: reserve accessible release territory; do not transplant the PVC slip-coupling sequence.
Read ../copper-terminal-renewal.md and the executable fixture. No material exception or house selection is earned.
